status.text: Branch protection is still OFF on main and develop (GitHub API, read 2026-11-23). Rules are enforced by CI and habit only.

Release 1.0.0 is on GitHub (tag v1.0.0, not a pre-release): installer, zip and SHA256SUMS. It has NEVER been run on a real shop laptop or printed on paper, and every GST rule is unverified until the CA confirms it. 0.9.0 (pre-release) was made first; its release run failed once (the release script did not start on Windows) and was fixed by hotfix #65.
Everything is merged: main has release 1.0.0; this hub refresh is one small pull request that also brings main's last merge commit back to develop.

rules: Never push to main or develop directly.
The owner merges and releases; the agent only opens pull requests.
ownerActions: Install ApparelPoS-Setup-1.0.0.exe on the real shop laptop (check its SHA-256 against SHA256SUMS.txt; click More info, then Run anyway) and follow documentation/owner_runbook.md section 8 end to end: recovery key on paper twice, the two backup places, the restore test on a second computer, test bills, returns, a dry-run day. Tell me what is wrong.
Print a hangtag sheet, a bill and a credit note slip on the real printer and scan the tags. Tell us the printer and scanner models.

Decide what bills and hangtags say until the phone app exists (the shop name, colour and logo cannot be set on the laptop yet). Choose the real shop or company name (it fixes the data folder; ADR-0018) and send an icon.

Take every GST rule to your CA before switching GST on (Settings, GST, owner only); it is off by default. Ask which GST reports they need and whether input tax should be set off the way the report shows it.
Confirm my assumptions, listed in the pull requests: low stock 2 or fewer; slow mover 30+ days and under 25% sold; trend 5%; markdown last day required; a return offsets only its own pay-later bill.
Accept or reject the SQLCipher community licence (ADR-0003 point 7).
Switch on branch protection for main and develop; require branch-policy, build-lint-test and dart-flutter-windows.
Review ADR-0003 (amended twice), ADR-0006, ADR-0013, ADR-0014 and ADR-0018 (Proposed; point 6 amended).

Plan Release 2 with me: sync and cloud (Firebase), the owner's phone app and web dashboard, a second counter. Open questions are listed in documentation/system_context.md and the plan's P4. Also say if you want an owner password reset, hangtag reprint, or the shop name on the laptop first.
